subject.title: fix(infra): scope Windows path realpath caches

question: After the branch is rebased, should OpenClaw accept these caller-scoped cache lifetimes for plugin and sandbox containment checks?
rationale: The implementation appears technically sound, but the affected checks enforce security boundaries and the current merge conflicts could change the reviewed cache ownership or caller behavior.

options.title: Rebase and approve scoped caches
options.body: Resolve the main conflicts without widening cache lifetime, rerun the focused Windows and sandbox tests, and obtain an owner review of the resolved containment paths.

options.title: Pause the optimization
options.body: Keep live uncached checks until maintainers define a different lifecycle-owned caching contract for these security-sensitive paths.

recommendation.title: Rebase and approve scoped caches
recommendation.body: Resolve the main conflicts without widening cache lifetime, rerun the focused Windows and sandbox tests, and obtain an owner review of the resolved containment paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The current infra path-wrapper history and recent adjacent sandbox work make this the strongest available owner signal for the cross-cutting cache contract.
